_comment: Estate spend policy. Thresholds are USD per LOCAL calendar day, measured by ~/.claude/scripts/estate_spend.py against Claude Code's own transcripts (not our logging). Changing policy is a config edit, never a code edit.
_halt_usd_note: 0 = DISARMED. Halt fires on the DAEMON leg only (prospector-daemon owner), because PAUSE can only stop the daemon; interactive coding is unstoppable and would otherwise trip it. warn_usd fires on the ESTATE total.
